english.note: Use 夠 as the everyday way to say that something is enough to meet a requirement.

exampleSentences.english: This money is enough to satisfy the rent requirement.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 cin4 gau3 gaau1 zou1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday equivalent of “be enough” or “suffice.”

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 sik6 mat6 gau3 m4 gau3 aa3
